messages:
maria: quick sync — i'm updating the private/vpc install guide. need a tiny connectivity validator for air-gapped installs (sgs/routes/proxy/ntp). any short snippet we can add?
ash: i can draft a bash validator that checks ports, DNS, and proxy env. keep it offline-friendly (no outbound to internet).
leo: add an openssl s_client TLS check for kms/hsm endpoints — folks forget CA chains in isolated envs.
ash: dropping a minimal example to start: 
```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# simple offline connectivity checks for install validation
set -e
TARGET_IP=10.0.0.2
TARGET_HOSTNAME=kms.local
# check TCP port 443
nc -zv ${TARGET_IP} 443 || echo "ERROR: 443 closed to ${TARGET_IP}"
# TLS handshake verification (returns a line with 'Verify return code')
openssl s_client -connect ${TARGET_IP}:443 -servername ${TARGET_HOSTNAME} </dev/null 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'verify return' || echo "WARN: tls verify info missing"
# DNS resolution (getent works in minimal images)
getent hosts ${TARGET_HOSTNAME} || echo "ERROR: dns lookup failed for ${TARGET_HOSTNAME}"
# proxy env check (common miss in airgapped setups)
if [[ -z "$HTTP_PROXY$HTTPS_PROXY$NO_PROXY" ]]; then echo "INFO: proxy env not set"; fi
```
samir: for HSM specifically, add a note about clock skew + OCSP/CRL unavailability. recommend importing issuer certs and using per-connection cert pinning or a 'verify_offline: true' option in the agent config example.
maria: good point. i'll add a short systemd unit snippet to run the validator at boot and a troubleshooting section referencing this script. i'll take the PR.
ash: i'll open a branch with the script + a tiny python alternative for windows admins. will include a doc test and a link to the example unit file.
